title: Saying Thank You and Expressing Gratitude
topicDisplay: Giao tiếp & Đời sống xã hội
description: Nhiều cách nói lời cảm ơn phong phú hơn câu 'Thank you' thông thường trong tiếng Anh.

coreVocabulary.contextSentence: I am immensely grateful for your timely assistance today.
I truly appreciate the effort you invested in this project.
Thank you for your warm hospitality and generosity.
